eyebrow: NoSQL, Document & Graph Databases · Chapter Five
subtitle: Lesson 24 · MongoDB Distribution & Scaling

eyebrow: Start each node in the set
code:
mongod --replSet "rs0" --port 27017 \
  --dbpath /data/rs0-0 \
  --bind_ip localhost,<hostname>

# repeat for each intended member,
# each with its own data directory
caption: Each node starts standalone, unaware of the others.

code:
rs.initiate({
  _id: "rs0",
  members: [{ _id: 0, host: "mongo1:27017" }]
})

rs.add("mongo2:27017")
rs.add("mongo3:27017")

rs.status()   // check health and sync state
caption: New members start in STARTUP2 during initial sync.
